method: OpenStreetMap way 44413083 (name 918) used verbatim. The North Area Consolidation page lists "PA852 b.911 Access point for ECN3 underground cavern" and "BX83 b.918 Counting rooms for ECN3 experimental cavern", and MapCERN lists building 918 as BX83. The cavern itself (the page calls it "Underground Experimental Cavern 3 (900)", 1887 m2) is underground and its outline is not published; these surface buildings mark where it is served.
